title: Applied Materials and Intel Launch Joint AI Chip Project
summary: Semiconductor hardware for artificial intelligence will be jointly researched at the EPIC Center under an agreement between Intel and Applied Materials. The two firms will co-develop AI chip technology and conduct research and development to advance processing capabilities for AI workloads.
